title: Durable planning mode
objective: Design a typed planning-mode workflow that compiles into executable GoalSpec state before agents start work.
prompt: Capture a chat-style planning session as durable questions, decisions, subgoals, and initial task seeds.
author: operator

authoring.intake_summary: We need planning mode like chat systems, but durable and typed.
constraints: SPA is optional and must use backend APIs
plans are not worker-owned global state
assumptions: goal-store is acceptable for pre-goal durable planning artifacts
open_questions: Which subgoals should be seeded immediately?

plan.summary: Create contracts, storage, UI, MCP, and docs for durable planning.

subgoals.title: Plan contracts
subgoals.objective: Define typed durable planning contracts and schemas.

distribution_notes: Compile the plan before execution; do not ask workers to infer subgoals from prose.

questions.question: Which subgoals should be seeded immediately?
